preflight_issues: dielectric 'slab' on x: 16.3 cells per λ_eff (eps_r=2.20, freq_max=12.4GHz, dx=1mm). Need ≥20 cells/λ_eff for phase-accurate propagation. S-parameter extraction amplifies ε-interface phase error into |S| magnitude error; ~5% |S21| deficit expected at 17 cells/λ_eff.

dielectric 'slab' on y: 16.3 cells per λ_eff (eps_r=2.20, freq_max=12.4GHz, dx=1mm). Need ≥20 cells/λ_eff for phase-accurate propagation. S-parameter extraction amplifies ε-interface phase error into |S| magnitude error; ~5% |S21| deficit expected at 17 cells/λ_eff.

all dielectric(s) ['slab'] are perfectly lossless in an open (CPML) domain. If you are measuring Q / resonance, this gives an ARTIFICIALLY infinite Q (design-guide Anti-Pattern #1, an R5 surface-metric trap) — add loss, e.g. sigma = 2*pi*f*eps0*eps_r*tan_delta. (Harmless if you are not measuring Q.)

Waveguide port 'left': max measurement frequency 12.400 GHz exceeds 0.90 × fc_next=11.803 GHz on the REALIZED guide (22.8600 x 10.1600 mm, declared geometry (non-uniform mesh)) (fc_TE10=6.557 GHz, fc_TE20=13.114 GHz). Evanescent TE20 contamination may exceed 1 % and registers as |S11| < 1 in a lossless structure. Restrict measurement freqs below 11.803 GHz or increase port-to-obstacle distance.

compute_warnings: compute_waveguide_s_matrix: absorber on the x propagation axis is thinner than the documented 0.5 guide-wavelength far-port discipline at the lowest measured frequency 8.200 GHz (mode cutoff 6.512 GHz, lambda_g = 60.2 mm): x-lo 20 cells = 20.0 mm (0.33 lambda_g), x-hi 20 cells = 20.0 mm (0.33 lambda_g), against a required 30.1 mm. A thin absorber reflects guided energy and can set the accuracy envelope instead of discretization: in the WR-90 iris lane (issue #494) residual |S11| ripple was 0.0706 at 0.30 lambda_g, 0.0366 at 0.50, and 0.0093 at 0.75, so 0.5 lambda_g is a floor and not a target. Raise cpml_layers to at least 31 (0.75 lambda_g needs 46).

the record is shorter than 3 x the far-boundary round trip — waveguide_port[0] (+x): T/tau_far = 1.399. T = 1.613 ns (1403 steps x dt = 1.1497 ps; num_periods = 20 at freq_max = 12.4 GHz), tau_far = 2 x far_path / v_g = 1.1527 ns. far_path = 105 mm (port plane 15 mm to the x-hi outer wall on a 100 mm domain, absorber pad 20 mm included); v_g(f_min)/c = 0.6077 at f_min = 8.2 GHz with the port's discrete cutoff f_c = 6.5122 GHz. num_periods >= 43 makes T/tau_far >= 3. Finer grids need more — measured 3, 5 and 8 at a/18, a/36 and a/72 on the WR-90 battery. A multimode port is audited on its lowest-cutoff mode, so this is a lower bound.

waveguide port index mirror audit, source E plane (x-axis): i(+) = 35, i(-) = 106, sum = 141 on n_axis = 141; the covariant sum for a primal plane is 140.
